protocol: RSAF pilot trainee during a Mark III chamber exposure. Narrative reports rapid decompression from 18,000 to 33,000 ft. Air/oxygen delivery through a pressure-demand regulator.
outcome_window: Reported tingling recalled at 18,000 ft, with numbness and upper-limb pain near peak altitude. Symptoms persisted after descent and resolved during recompression.
locator: Case No. 2, p. 351, narrative and Figure 1
note: DCS was considered the most likely diagnosis. Total trainees in this flight and in the surveillance population were unavailable. The aircraft case is outside the chamber scope.
